steps.content: You drive all the way to Eastside while Dolly sleep-talks on the way.
Most of them are about baseball, like "See how you catch my home run" and "Let's watch a baseball game together next time."

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: Where... are we? I thought we were heading back to the Bureau.
How was your nap?
You pull the brakes and park the car.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: This is... near the Eastside Baseball Stadium? What did you bring me here for? Playing Baseball?

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: ...You know all too well that I can't play baseball anymore.
Not baseball, of course. We're working overtime.
You open the vehicle door for Dolly. The stadium is surrounded by firefighters and busy FAC members.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: What... is going on here?
A Corruptor attack.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: Sorry, Chief. I... I can't do it here...
Dolly stares at the stage she once dreamed to be in, raising and lowering the baseball bat in her hand. Maybe she doesn't think she deserve to swing her bat here anymore.
Of course, it's totally fine if you say no. This place means a lot to you, after all.
Bang—
The Eastside stadium starts to shake violently and the outer brick wall begins to crumble as you speak.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief, the Corruptors are rushing out from underground. Please act now.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Or the Eastside Stadium might collapse completely.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: Collapse...?
Dolly has refused the mission. Please send me another Sinner.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: I am joining the mission!

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: Even if I have to use my ability here... It's better than the place being destroyed by Corruptors!

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: I'm going to totally crush the Corruptors this time! They were the ones who caused me to be like this...

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Great. Then, mission continues.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: The objective of this mission: to evacuate the spectators as much as possible.
You show your ID card to the FACs around you and enter the Eastside Stadium with Dolly.
Corruptors crawl out from the ground continually. Luckily, they don't move fast.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: I'm already... doing it!
Dolly carries the baseball bat behind her back and punches the attacking Corruptors only with her fists.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: You're safe now... Go.

steps.speaker: Spectator
steps.content: But I paid for my ticket...

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: Forget about the ticket! Just get the hell out of here!

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: Or I'll kill you too.

steps.speaker: Spectator
steps.content: I-I... I'm going now! Gosh!
Looking at the spectators fleeing in a panic, you quietly sigh. Thankfully, Dolly is doing her best to rescue people.
Hopefully, her emotions won't get out of hand during the rescue, or it'll be big trouble.

options: Can I trust your "emotions" this time?

choices.text: Can I trust your "emotions" this time?

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: Humph... Of course you can.
You travel all the way from the east to the west of the stadium, rescuing many who didn't manage to escape along the way.
Some thank Dolly, while others are scared away by her.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Scanning the site...

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: There is one sign of life remaining, 43 meters to your east, under the spectators' seats.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: After rescuing this person, focus on the underground cave under the stadium center where Corruptors generated. The current earthquake level is 4.1, which suggests more Corruptors under the ground, so hurry up!
Before Nightingale can finish, Dolly lifts all the seats in front of her with her bat.
As expected, a middle-aged man is shivering underneath.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: Go.

steps.speaker: Middle-Aged Spectator
steps.content: Wh-Who... Who are you?

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: We're here to save you. Don't be ungrateful.

steps.speaker: Middle-Aged Spectator
steps.content: To save me... Well, you're really lucky. If you mention my name to the Eastside Baseball Club, you'll get special privileges!

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: Just shut up and go. I still have those Corruptors to fight.

steps.speaker: Middle-Aged Spectator
steps.content: Hold on... You look like... Are you...
The middle-aged man's expression changes rapidly.

steps.speaker: Middle-Aged Spectator
steps.content: You're the one who messed up the game two years ago! That baseball monster girl!

steps.speaker: Middle-Aged Spectator
steps.content: Did you know?! Did you know how much I bet on that game?!

steps.speaker: Middle-Aged Spectator
steps.content: Tsk. Gosh, what a bummer.

steps.speaker: Middle-Aged Spectator
steps.content: Damn you disgusting Syndican! Ah—Aaah!!
Dolly swings a punch straight at the man. He is knocked off the glass fence to the ground.

steps.speaker: Middle-Aged Spectator
steps.content: How... How dare you hit me?! I'm a member of the Eastside Baseball Club!

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: Can I pretend I've never seen this guy?
Yes, you can. But scumbags have the right to live too.
No, you can't. But you have my permission to give him one more kick.

steps.speaker: Middle-Aged Spectator
steps.content: You... You're her boss, right? Help me! Help!
You look to Dolly and wait for her to decide.
Dolly lifts the man by the collar.

steps.speaker: Middle-Aged Spectator
steps.content: Ah... I'm telling you... I'm telling you, think twice!
With Dolly's powerful toss, the man is thrown to an emergency exit.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: Now you remember! You're saved by a Syndican!

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: And it's a Syndican who's about to enter the stadium too! Got it?!
Without turning back, Dolly walks toward the center of the stadium.
The ground starts to shake even more violently, as if something is about to burst out from the ground.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief! We have an emergency!

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: A giant monster is coming out in the Eastside Stadium. Mission aborted. Retreat now!
You hear an extremely anxious Nightingale from the comms.
Dolly, however, walks straight toward the center of the stadium as if she hears nothing.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Dolly the Sinner! Stop going forward! Stop now!
Dolly tosses her headset to the ground and gets into a batting pose.
The ground trembles as a bizarre monster emerges from underground, rushing straight to the opponent in front of it.

steps.speaker: Monster
steps.content: Roarrrr—

steps.speaker: Monster
steps.content: What a blessing... What a blessing!

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: Ah... How ironic.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: I'm on the stage of my dreams now.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: But doing this kind of drudge work.
The battlefield is your stadium, and the stadium right now is your battlefield.
It's just that this time, instead of spectators, you are facing a monster.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: Ha... You don't have to comfort me like that. I get it.
I know you won't get to play baseball anymore, but I'm here with you, to let you fulfill your dreams on the battlefield.
These monsters are your strongest and best opponents.
While I am your best coach.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: Gosh. You never know when to shut up, do you?

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: I wish I had a quieter coach.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: Haha... Pity I don't have a choice.
Dolly's hand reaches behind her back for her baseball bat.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: Let's start the game, coach.
Dolly swings her bat and her ability is activated in an instant.
She leaps up high, swings her arms in full force, and smashes the bat into the monster with all her strength.
Like a moth chasing the light, the closer it gets to the light it desires, the closer it is to destruction.
But what if the moth is destruction itself?
That's probably something nobody has never experienced.
The monster lets out an ear-piercing shrill and collapses to the ground as if it has lost its shape.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: Mission accomplished! You did a good job this time. It's probably one of the few missions I enjoyed.
You enjoyed fighting the monster?

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: Humph, definitely not as much as teaching that fat Eastsider a lesson.
The light that belongs to her has finally come.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: So why am I still being locked up here?
Because you disobeyed orders, of course.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: ...What? Come on!
And I am with you.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: But you're outside!?

options: That's my privileges as a coach.

choices.text: That's my privileges as a coach.

steps.content: Anyway, why don't you tell me about that letter you wrote to yourself in three years?

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: Urgh... Whatever. Just stop bugging me.
Dear Dolly in three years,
By the time you are reading this letter again, I'm sure you'll be on the Eastside baseball podium, ready to accept the "Best Hitter" award.
Haha... Just kidding, of course. I've considered the possibility of not being able to win at all after getting to Eastside.
By then, I'll definitely work ten times harder than I do now, because this is my dream.
I won't be distressed even if I don't get famous in the end.
After all, I'll have proved myself. And I'll have done my best in this stadium.
Alright, I guess that's it for now.
I gotta leave early for Eastside. It's so big there, you don't wanna get lost.
